title: Gully at the door
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies (the trilogy ran in print in three papers)
logline: Gully comes by every day this week with something. Wood doesn't open the door. Gully leaves it on the step. A daily of the step.

panels.composition: The porch, morning, frost. GULLY setting a paper sack on the top cedar step. Knocking once. Not waiting.

characters.pose: setting down a sack, knocking once

image.prompt: a stocky man in a brown canvas work jacket setting a paper sack on the top cedar step of a small porch and knocking once on an aluminum storm door, frost, desaturated wash, no words

panels.composition: Gully walking away down the gravel. Hood down. Hands in pockets. Not looking back. The strip's first rehearsal of the walk it will draw properly in six days.

image.prompt: a stocky man walking away down a gravel driveway toward a flatbed truck with his hands in his jacket pockets, not looking back, frost on the puddles, no words
image.notes: Rehearsal of 'The Box' Tier 1. Same walk. Six days early.

panels.composition: The sack on the step. Grease-stained. Warm, drawn as a faint curl of steam. Fried clams.

image.prompt: close-up of a grease-stained paper sack on a frosted cedar step with a faint curl of steam rising from it, no words

panels.composition: The storm door opening a hand's width. A hand taking the sack. The door closing. That's all of Wood the strip shows this week.

image.prompt: an aluminum storm door opened a hand's width, a man's hand reaching out to take a paper sack from the step, no words
image.notes: Wood is a hand this week. The rule's own devices: absence.

art.line: quiet; water bleeding over the ink edge to suggest rain and fading light
art.palette: desaturated wet-on-wet: raw umber, Payne's gray, Prussian blue, raw sienna
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for the Sundays

notes: Fried clams on the step every day. Wood is a hand. Six days before 'The Box.'
